description_excerpt: About the Role The Senior Specialist, Production Delivery Management leads complex PO change management and delivery-risk coordination across a broader or higher-risk portfolio. The role provides advanced analytics and a data-centric view of supply and delivery risks, partners with Production Services and other relevant functions to facilitate cross-functional decisions and coaches PDM Specialists and vendors in disciplined PO and WIP practices.
